PUNJAB CHARITIES (INSPECTION AND AUDIT)
RULES, 2023
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
27th November, 2023]
No.E&A(HD)14-2/2019(P-II),
dated 21-11-2023.---In exercise of
the powers conferred under section 38 of the Punjab Charities Act 2018 (V of
2018), Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make the following rules:
1. Short
title and commencement.- (1) These
rules may be cited as the Punjab Charities (Inspection and Audit) Rules, 2023.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.- (1) In the rules, unless the subject or context
requires otherwise:
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Charities Act, 2018 (V of 2018);
(b) "auditor"
means a chartered accountant as defined in the Chartered Accountants Ordinance,
1961 (X of 1961) or a cost and management accountant as defined in the Cost and
Management Accountants Act, 1966 (XIV of 1966) or any officer notified by the
Commission;
(c) "charitable
activity" means the solicitation, collection, retention, custody,
Investment, utilization, distribution etc. of charitable funds and includes
receiving of donations, charity, grant, aid, contribution, gift, assistance,
subsidy etc, directly or indirectly, whether in cash or in kind from any local
or foreign source;
(d) "inspector"
means an officer appointed by the Commission or sanctioning authority to
inspect the record of a charity or charitable fund;
(e) "record"
includes the books of account, statement of accounts, title deeds, vouchers,
receipts, other relevant document or electronic records (including computer and
digital data information) or nature and source of charitable funds regarding a
charity;
(f) "relevant
person" includes a person:
(a) who
is or has been a charity trustee, promoter, collector, donor, beneficiary,
officer, employee or auditor of a charity or a charitable fund during the
relevant period;
(b) who
holds or has held under his custody or control the charitable fund or the
records during the relevant period; or
(c) to
whom a query or a request is made or notice is issued in connection with an
inspection or audit under the rules;
(g) "rules"
means the Punjab Charities (Inspection and Audit) Rules, 2023; and
(h) "Schedule"
means the Schedule appended to the rules.
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the rules shall have the same
meaning as assigned to it in the Act.
3. Inspection.-
(1) The Commission or sanctioning
authority may, from time to time, inspect or cause to be inspected a record
relating to a charity or charitable fund to evaluate the performance and ensure
the compliance of the Act rules and applicable laws.
(2) The
record of every charity or charitable fund shall be open to inspection by the
Commission or sanctioning authority or any officer authorized by the Commission
or sanctioning authority.
(3) The
Commission or sanctioning authority may appoint one or more officers as
inspectors in the form as set out in Schedule-I and authorize them to
inspect the record of a charity or charitable fund.
(4) An
Inspector shall have power to:
(a) access
the record;
(b) require
the relevant person to produce any record;
(c) inspect
the movable and immovable property (including leased property) in the name of
the charity or charitable fund;
(d) make
inquiry and seek explanation from the relevant person and require him
to furnish further particular and
explanation thereto;
(e) require any
person to make a statement of the facts on oath;
(f) inspect
and make copies or take extracts from such record at the expense of the charity
or the charitable fund;
(g) take
possession of the record, subject to issuance of a receipt in respect thereof;
(h) place
marks of identification of the inspection; and
(i) seek
such direction from the Commission or sanctioning authority as may be required
to complete the Inspection effectively.

inspector shall, at least seven days prior to conducting the inspection, issue
